fields: Bell jingles out the motif of the area. Bird is summoned.
Looks like a perch for a bird. It has been heavily used. There’s a sign nearby that reads Ring the bell!

During flights. Penny will talk to you about random various things. I’ll include a list of stuff she’ll go through, but this first one will be scripted. After a certain amount of flights you can unlock her scene. Also maybe you need to be in like, act 3 or something.
[pic=2]Have you ever been up this high?
[pic=1]Don’t you worry dear, I’ve never dropped a critter before.
[pic=3]Poor old Fred, he was a good bun…
[pic=1]BAHAWHAW Just kidding! You’ll be fine dear!
[pic=2]Oh and look! Here is your stop!
[pic=1]I’ll take it you’re trembling from excitement then!
[pic=1]Most critters nearly piss themselves from fear their first time!
[pic=3]Oh uh, don’t worry, I thoroughly wash after those incidents.
[pic=2]I’ve been doing these flights long before you were born.
Bird drops off Red, and lands on the perch.
[pic=2]Thanks for choosing Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom!
[pic=1]I hope you had an enjoyable flight, and we’ll see you again real soon!
[pic=2]The perch is just on the other side of the river.
[pic=1]So until that bridge is fixed, I’ll be dropping critters off here.
[pic=3]This is off the record, and against policy, so don’t tell my boss!
[pic=2]So how’s your stay been so far?
[pic=3]Lots of folks seem to enjoy being busy, but personally, I like the slower pace of things…
[pic=1]Oh gosh, maybe I’m just getting old!
[pic=2]Aaand here we are! Please remain seated while we begin our descent!
[pic=2]Bahaw! I hear you’ve been running some errands!
[pic=4]The folks are keeping you busy, eh?
[pic=6]Don’t worry, that means they like ya!
[pic=7]Though… We might be coming up on some turbulence…
[pic=1]Look’s like we’re here though, prepare to descend!
[pic=4]This is your fourth trip with me. How do you like flying?

It’s actually incredible!
The sights are magnificent.
[pic=4]Right? It’s crazy to think! There’s SO MUCH space up here!
[pic=3]It’s a shame only us flyin’ folk can appreciate it.
[pic=2]I’m so glad I can share it with you critters!
[pic=2]Oh! Here we are! Prepare for landing!

Still pretty scary…
And your jokes don’t help!
[pic=1]Baww! Hah! That’s tough love for ya, Rascal!
[pic=3]Y’know, most of us birds learn how to fly by FALLING. A LOT!
[pic=4]Gotta rip off that bandaid, y’know? Only then will you see that things aren’t so scary!
[pic=6]Besides, the jokes are a complementary service! Those aren’t goin’ anywhere, bahaw!
[pic=2]Y’know, I’ve been seeing you a lot today…
[pic=4]Normally I don’t see the same critter more than twice a day…
[pic=1]Not that I mind of course! I’ll ferry your cute rump all day long!
[pic=6]Oh gosh, don’t tell my boss I’m flirting with you! Bahaw!
[pic=6]Right? I hear the flight attendant isn’t half bad lookin’ either!
[pic=3]Must be nice, I keep gettin’ stuck with these lazy free loaders!
[pic=6]Y’all got legs, don’tcha? Bahaw just messin’, dear!

The sign reads: Ring the bell!
Now, if you only had a bell…

[pic=2]Each of the bells are in their own key and ring out a specific jingle that helps me figure out where you are! See, sounds echo quite aimlessly up in the sky, so this helps speed up the process!
[pic=2]I only offer pick up and drop off at the designated perches! It’s all part of the terms and services! (also apparently emergency rescue services…)
[pic=1]Finally, by riding Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom you accept any and all accidental damages that can happen and may result in permanent damage, and or death!
[pic=2]OK With that all out of the way, where would you like to go?
Player can only choose the Central Forest
Player can only choose the Central Forest
[pic=2]I bet you’re wondering what’s with this bell you rang, eh?
[pic=1]See, I run a little business here! Would you like to hear my lil’ spiel?
[pic=2]Welcome to Penny Plume’s, Ride and Zoom!
[pic=2]The name’s Penny, as you know, and I’ll be your flight attendant today!
[pic=1]… And every other day. I’m the only one who works at Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom.
[pic=2]Let me explain how it works! I’ve given these bells to everyone in the forest, and when a critter needs a ride, they can ring the bell and I’ll pick them up!
[pic=2]She can go mama-bear sometimes, but she means well.
[pic=6]Trust me, I’ve had my fair share of scolds from her!
[pic=7]Oh! Looks like we’re here! Hold on tight!
Uh, Yeah! … Sorry, do I know you?
[pic=5]You probably weren’t conscious at the time… but I was the one who found you.
[pic=5]I was flying my normal routes, and I saw you collapsed on the ground!
[pic=5]I didn’t know how to help, so I took you to Scarlett immediately.
[pic=5]I’ve been busy working, so I couldn’t stop by to see how you were doing. It’s been plaguing me all day!
[pic=4]But I’m so happy to see you are doing ok!
[pic=1]Baww, no worries dear. Again, just glad to see you’re okay.
[pic=2]Let me know if this is too much for you right now! I know you might not be feeling well.
[pic=3]Oh look, that’s the clearing where I found you.
… I, uh… Didn’t get a lot of sleep…
[pic=1]Hah! I’m guessing Scarlett gave you an earful already?
Penny is on a date right now! Better try again later.
[pic=2]All this glowing glyph business has been super exciting!
[pic=4]Good things actually! I think they’re becoming more curious about it.
[pic=3]I feel like things are just beginning!
